answer: Counterparty diversity gates rewards: an agent earns full pay only after trading with 12 distinct counterparties, its score shown like a lantern over its stall. A ring of 100 fakes trades with itself, so each fake sees 3 partners and earns a tenth. The fable of effortless scale dies: forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits of 40 POA, or 4,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one deposit for full rewards. Only varied trade reaches the zenith.
